unattended_stop: restarts the session it was showing, at most twice in five minutes; needs package 3.0.0~beta.6 or later
remembered_phone: address of the last phone reached is kept in this browser (never the token); a reloaded page reconnects by itself and rejoins a running session; Connect works as before if the browser refuses
shrunk_browser: package 3.0.0~beta.7 or later keeps CarPlay for 15 minutes without a browser; earlier packages stop after 90 seconds (beta 6) or 12 seconds
